Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_Enabled_toolti: If false, this mod's unseasonal weather events are disabled.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_DailyEventChan: Approximate chance per day for an unseasonal weather event to occur.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_MinDuration_to: Shortest possible duration of a single unseasonal weather event.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_MaxDuration_to: Longest possible duration of a single unseasonal weather event.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_IntensityMulti: Scales the strength of unseasonal weather events. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_HardcoreWinter: Enable brutal polar snaps and blizzards with very low temperatures. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_HardcoreSummer: Enable scorching heatwaves with very high temperatures. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_DryEvents_tool: If true, unseasonal weather events keep their temperature, wind, fog and cloud changes but do not generate rain or snow.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_EnhancedRainEx: Rain now increases wetness progressively. Prolonged high wetness amplifies cold damage indirectly; rain does not cause direct illness.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_LightningAttra: If true, lightning strikes emit a strong world sound that attracts zombies like a global meta event. Default: off.
Sandbox_UnseasonalWeather_ClockUIEnabled: If true, Unseasonal Weather uses its custom minute-precision clock UI. If false, it is disabled and the normal clock is used.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_Enabled_tool: If false, all SPEC radio forecasts are disabled.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_UseNightWind: If true, schedules broadcasts between 20:00 and 23:00; otherwise between 08:00 and 11:00.
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_WalkieHints_: If true, active walkies show subtle WX scanner readings (default: on).
Sandbox_UW_RadioForecasting_DebugLogging: If true, print broadcast text to console for verification.
